title: Phasing language-packages doesn't seem useful to me given that the only crash reports we would get about them would be of the "Type: Package" (package install failures) which should surface other ways.
description: Phasing language-packages doesn't seem useful to me given that the only crash reports we would get about them would be of the "Type: Package" (package install failures) which should surface other ways.
diff:
diff --git a/phased-updater b/phased-updater
index a1c2aea..8a64905 100755
--- a/phased-updater
+++ b/phased-updater
@@ -734,7 +734,8 @@ def main():
                     new_pup = current_pup + PUP_SLOW_INCREMENT
                 if src_pkg in MEDIUM_PACKAGES:
                     new_pup = current_pup + PUP_MEDIUM_INCREMENT
-                if src_pkg in FULLY_PHASED_PACKAGES:
+                if (src_pkg in FULLY_PHASED_PACKAGES or
+                        src_pkg.startswith('language-pack')):
                     new_pup = 100
                 if not options.no_act:
                     set_pup(current_pup, new_pup, release, suite, src_pkg)
